categories_thin: Staffing: only Staff Management Group could be confirmed with an Edison street address and office page; the other Edison staffing offices found were franchise branches (PrideStaff, Express Employment Professionals) or national firms, which are excluded.

Title agencies and appraisers: Edison title work is concentrated in a few suites (55 Carter Drive, 100 Plainfield Avenue). Investors Title and Supreme Title could only be confirmed through a Yellow Pages listing that blocks direct fetch, and several other hits turned out to be in South Plainfield (ZIP 07080) and were left out.
Environmental consulting: few Edison-headquartered firms; most environmental consultants serving Edison are based in Somerset, East Brunswick or outside the zone.

Insurance: many Edison 'agencies' are branded franchise agencies (State Farm, Allstate, Farmers, GEICO) and were excluded, so the independent agency count is lower than the raw listing count suggests.

Accounting: after applying the checker's test (live website or independent confirmation) to the iBegin accounting page, about twenty single-person CPA listings had no verifiable presence and were dropped, leaving 16 accounting entries.
caveats: Zone is Edison township only. Nearby Metuchen, Fords, Iselin, Woodbridge, New Brunswick, South Plainfield and East Brunswick were treated as outside the zone and excluded.

Radius was not measured in this pass. Raritan Center addresses (300 and 523 Raritan Center Parkway) sit at Edison's north-west edge and could be at or beyond 10 straight-line miles from central Milltown; that is unverified here and should be checked before outreach.

Accounting entries from the iBegin bulk directory were kept only where the firm has a live website or a second current source; the rest were dropped as unverifiable. iBegin attorney, insurance, real-estate and architecture records were retained as single-directory leads (the schema allows 'one directory only') because no equivalent staleness evidence was found for them - the triage team should confirm each.

Removed in this revision (previously listed): True Shield Insurance Agency (domain did not resolve, no Edison listing found), Eisner & Lubin LLP and J.H. Cohn (defunct/merged, stale iBegin records), Professional Accountants Association (an association, not a practice), Aditya Ravipati CPA / TaxAssist Advisors (franchise-branded practice), Cornell Insurance Services (listed as Foundation Risk Partner Corp. dba Cornell Insurance Services, i.e. part of a national consolidator group), Tvisha Technologies (own site shows only 'New Jersey'; search results place it in Iselin, outside the zone), Gitterman Wealth Management (dba of national RIA Perigon; no Edison address on its own pages).

Removed because Edison presence could not be confirmed on any page I could open: Colucci Law Firm, SG Healthcare & Pharma Tech, Leo Wealth, Endeavor Property Management, ITCG Solutions, Soluzione, Qantler Technologies, Source Sphere, VinzoTech, Equity Wealth Solutions, Nevas Technologies, Raj Patel CPA, C&C Computer Network Services, Geeksoft, Nectar, Creative Fount, ESuccess Solutions, Malecki Financial Group, Abacora Title Agency (ZIP 07080 is South Plainfield), Lipman Selznick & Witkowski (merged into a larger firm).
Four staffing entries (Mintex, Langford, RIM, Helix) rest on the firm's own Edison city page rather than a published street address; they are kept for coverage with that limitation stated in notes.
Website fields are filled only where I opened the site or saw the URL linked from a listing; 'Unknown' addresses are ones the business does not publish on the pages I could open.
data_gaps: Yellow Pages, BBB, Manta, Superpages and WhereOrg block direct fetches (HTTP 403) from this environment; entries sourced from them are marked single-directory/unconfirmed.
Overpass/OpenStreetMap was not queried and Google/Bing Maps place listings were not browsed, so review recency is missing for most entries.
Edison Township does not publish a browsable licensed-business directory; no municipal list could be mined.
Several firms publish no street address at all (Wang Insurance, Ark Wealth, DINI, Kaizen, NJREAG, Mintex, RIM, Helix, K&K Design, Wong Tsai & Fleming), so those addresses remain Unknown.

The checker's LinkedIn-only entries could not be independently confirmed: LinkedIn company pages are not readable here and none of those firms' own sites states an Edison address, so they were dropped rather than carried forward. Confirming them would need the NJ business-name search (NJ Division of Revenue), which was not usable from this environment.
